instruction: Align the top edges of the three bottom images on the first slide so they are horizontally aligned.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task asks user to align the top edges of three images at the bottom of slide 1. The three images are Picture 7 (at y=5486400), Picture 3 (at y=381000), and one Picture 2 instance (at y=155335). Custom getter extracts positions of all three images, and metric checks if their top edges are aligned within tolerance of 0.1 inches (91440 EMUs). The evaluator checks alignment_type='top' to verify the top edges are aligned.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement to align top edges of three specified images (Picture 7, Picture 3, Picture 2)
Getter correctly extracts position properties (left, top, width, height) for all three images from slide index 0
Metric correctly compares top values of all images against tolerance (91440 EMUs = 0.1 inches) to verify top edge alignment
Data flow is correct: getter extracts image positions -> metric compares 'top' values -> returns 1.0 if aligned within tolerance
Expected configuration correctly specifies image_names and alignment_type='top' matching the instruction
Postconfig appropriately saves the file (Ctrl+S) ensuring getter can access current state
Edge cases handled properly: missing images, invalid alignment types, insufficient images all return 0.0
Complete coverage: evaluator checks exactly what the instruction requires - no missing or extra verification steps
